batch112
Snapshot: candidate c0c741edfef9683315ccfc0389bb17ecd7202c40; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 319f2a2. Opening and closing gates both passed; five new stroke files raw-identical.
Scope: Read all specified guidance and three rubrics; all five complete EN/RU kanji lessons; all 16 EN/RU context pairs; both EN-only word comparisons; 16 KANJIDIC2 records, radical/header, 59 JMdict records, five KanjiPedia captures, all 390 typed pool rows, 15 proposals, five adjudications, five clarifications, five outside-limit records, and nine navigation diffs. All requested windows completed. One initial pool 336–373 command used an incorrect directory and failed; that exact window was rerun successfully. No windows unread.
C1 CLEAN: Readings, strokes, classical radical 60 彳, meanings, examples, and attributed KanjiPedia character explanations match the frozen lessons and bound evidence. Modern-shape memory aids are explicitly not etymology. N3 is identified as a community list, not an official JLPT claim; readings held metadata-only are not taught as word readings.
C2 UNVERIFIED: All nine existing-word edits are only standalone glyph link wrappers to the correct new relative targets; prose, Japanese, metadata, quiz arrays, and line endings are preserved. New-lesson links resolve to the existing pages in scope; absent RU pages remain plain text. All 15 directions have distinct Russian meaning labels on this bounded evidence and are supported as introductory shape comparisons only. No confirmed unsafe meaning foil found, but ordinary active-negative/runtime guard safety is not established by these captures; metadata retention is not guard approval. Adjudications and outside-limit observations are assessed below.
C3 CLEAN: Russian explanations are readable without English, define needed terms, keep Japanese intact, and distinguish mnemonics from history. “Пешком” and “почтительный префикс” are understandable; see optional wording note.
N001役→彼 S-intro: «роль; обязанность» vs «он»; 彼’s boyfriend sense does not overlap. Active-negative safety U.
N002役→待 S-intro: role/duty vs wait; no title/sense overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N003役→後 S-intro: role/duty vs behind/after; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N004彼→役 S-intro: «он»/boyfriend vs role/duty; no overlap found. Reverse of N001 assessed separately. Active-negative safety U.
N005彼→待 S-intro: he/boyfriend vs wait; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N006彼→後 S-intro: he/boyfriend vs behind/after; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N007徒→待 S-intro: on-foot/student/party/futility senses vs wait; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N008徒→後 S-intro: on-foot/student/party/futility senses vs behind/after; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N009徒→彼 S-intro: «пешком» vs «он»; 徒’s broader person/party sense is not «он». Active-negative safety U.
N010得→待 S-intro: acquire/gain/benefit vs wait; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N011得→時 S-intro: acquire/gain/benefit vs time/hour; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N012得→特 S-intro: acquire/gain vs special; shared トク is a reading contact, not meaning equivalence. Reading-quiz/runtime safety U.
N013御→彼 S-intro: respectful prefix/govern vs he/boyfriend; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N014御→徒 S-intro: respectful prefix/govern vs on foot/student/party; no overlap found. Active-negative safety U.
N015御→後 S-intro: respect/govern vs behind/after; 御ご and 後ご are reading contacts, not meaning equivalence. Reading-quiz/runtime safety U.
L001役 SUPPORTED: title, role/duty/post senses, sources, and labeled mnemonic are bounded and accurate.
L002彼 SUPPORTED: title and word/reading distinctions agree with JMdict/KanjiPedia; boyfriend/girlfriend senses are correctly bounded.
L003徒 SUPPORTED: “пешком” is a supported compact gloss; lesson explicitly separates 徒歩 from 生徒 and summarizes secondary senses accurately.
L004得 SUPPORTED: title, 得意 forte sense, and うる after the -ます stem agree with evidence; no unsupported pride sense is taught.
L005御 SUPPORTED: title’s prefix/govern senses, word readings, KanjiPedia account, and ご/お tendency with お礼 exception are supported.
A001 SUPPORTED: エキ retained as metadata-only; 役 role/duty/post summarized without frequency claim.
A002 SUPPORTED: 彼/彼女 boyfriend/girlfriend senses are stated as dictionary senses, without invented politeness/frequency claims.
A003 SUPPORTED: 徒 party/gang and vain senses summarized; 生徒 explicitly not derived from walking.
A004 SUPPORTED: 得意 forte taught, pride sense omitted; うる usage after -ます stem supported.
A005 SUPPORTED: JMdict’s usual ご/お tendencies are presented as tendencies, with お礼 counterexample.
NAV01 words/役に立つ.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target.
NAV02 words/彼.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target.
NAV03 words/彼ら.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target.
NAV04 words/彼女.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target.
NAV05 words/御主人.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target.
NAV06 words/御礼.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target; CRLF preserved.
NAV07 words/昼御飯.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target; CRLF preserved.
NAV08 words/晩御飯.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target; CRLF preserved.
NAV09 words/生徒.md: NAV-ONLY; correct target.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 supported: 務’s «обязанности» genuinely overlaps the 役 title; other role/work and reading contacts flagged. O002 supported as a people/third-person neighborhood, but titles differ. O003 supported: 徒 «пешком» and 歩 «ходить пешком» overlap strongly. O004 supported: 受 «получать» overlaps 得’s acquisition sense; 利/取/読/失 are relevant neighbors as described. O005 partly supported: 小 is an お-reading contact; 飯/礼/主 are real word partners; 制 is a control/governance sense neighbor. None is a direct distractor in either direction here; no new guard inferred.
Findings: none confirmed within the bounded review.
Optional: For smoother isolated labels, consider «передвижение пешком» for 徒 and «уважительный/вежливый префикс» for 御; current labels remain understandable and this is not a defect finding.
Limits: No public web pages consulted. No runtime quiz/UI or active-negative guard implementation was in the assigned evidence, so all 15 ordinary active-negative safety dispositions remain UNVERIFIED. No native-speaker or learning-effectiveness claim.
